Name: (AT)(CP) Pixie's MCM Wallpaper and Flooring
Author: caterpixies
Description:
[center][b][b][b][b][b][b][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b][/center][center][b][b][b][b][b][b]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b]


[size=3]This is a collection of wallpapers and floors in the mid-century modern style![/size][size=3] They are all meant to fit together in a cohesive color palette with my other MCM mods.
[/size]


[size=4][b]How to Use:[/b][/size]

[size=3][u]Content Patcher ver.[/u][/size][size=3]
1. [b]In game[/b]: purchase the wallpaper catalogue from [b]Pierre's
[/b]2. The wallpapers will be located int he catalogue. I recommend using Happy Home Designer for better organization[b]

[/b][size=3][u]Alternative Textures ver.[/u][/size]
[/size][size=3]1. Download Alternative Textures
2. [b]In game: [/b]Purchase the [b]paint bucket[/b] from Robin's shop
3. Use the paint bucket to select the wallpaper option you want
[/size][size=3]
[/size]

[size=4][b]FAQ:[/b][/size][size=3][b]

[u][/u][/b][/size][size=3][b][u][/u][/b][size=3][size=3][b][u] When is the rest of the collection coming out?[/u][/b]
Honestly, I’m working full-time and going to school, so this is kind of just a
hobby for me. I'm also really anal about how I want everything to look,
so it takes me a bit of time. But I’m definitely (probably) working on it and I’ll
release stuff as it’s ready!

[b][u]Q: What’s next on the roadmap?[/u][/b]
[/size]I'm wanting to make this collection as modular as possible, so with that in
mind I want to make a separate painting/decoration/clutter pack which
might be next! Or I also want to work on living room stuff, so whichever
inspires me more tbh.[/size][/size]
[size=3][b]

[size=4][b]Contact me:

[/b][/size][/b]If you have any questions or suggestions about my mods, feel free to shoot me a DM and I'll look at it when I'm able to. 
You can also message me on Discord (it's probably the fastest way to get to me): caterpixie[b]
